english.title: Owner of a dog worrying livestock
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the owner of a dog which worried livestock, namely **(..SPECIFY TYPE OF LIVESTOCK..), on agricultural land situated at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (6) of the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) Act 1953.

english.notes:
(i) This offence no longer applies after 17/03/2026 due to changes made by the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) (Amendment) Act 2025. For the offence of owner of a dog attacking/worrying livestock under section 1 of the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) Act 1953 applying after this date, see H102636.

(ii) On rare occasions the consent of the Chief Constable or his deputy (there seems to be no provision for this authority to be delegated further down the rank structure) may be required before court proceedings can commence. There are four different categories of party that can institute proceedings -

the chief officer of police for the police area in which the land is situated;
the occupier of the land;
the owner of any of the livestock in question;
anyone else with the consent of the chief officer of police for the police area in which the land is situated. (E.g. the R.S.P.C.A)

If the last category applies, and no other force system is in place, add the following wording, filled in as far as possible by you, to the front of the file for the Chief Officer etc. to sign:

I (name of Chief Constable/Deputy Chief Constable/ACC Designate) AS CHIEF CONSTABLE/DEPUTY CHIEF CONSTABLE/ASSISTANT CHIEF CONSTABLE DESIGNATE OF (police force) CONSENT TO PROCEEDINGS BEING BROUGHT BY (state the party wishing to prosecute), AGAINST (name of offender) OF (address of offender), FOR ALLOWING HIS DOG TO WORRY LIVESTOCK CONTRARY TO SECTION 1(1) AND SECTION 1(6) OF THE DOGS (PROTECTION OF LIVESTOCK) ACT 1953 ON (specify date) AT (specify location) WHICH IS LAND WITHIN THE TERRITORIAL AREA OF THIS POLICE FORCE.

SIGNED .......................................................... DATE.............

(iii) Also consider:-
H592 - person in charge of a dog worrying livestock,H569 - dog not under proper control (complaint only),
H11472 - owner / person in charge of dog dangerously out of control causing injury
H11473 - owner / person in charge of a dog dangerously out of control - no injury
